name: FSS noise (frequency soft-select, reference phase)
plain: Same core concept as structured noise, written independently: takes noise magnitudes and mixes phase from a reference with noise phase using a soft cut-off mask. Ref phase comes as a separate LATENT input from a frequency split node.
math: |F_n| from noise; M=1 inside cutoff else exp(−(r−r₀)²/(2σ²)); φ=φ_ref·M + φ_n·(1−M); outputs |F_n| and φ as two latents. Combine node: ifft2(|F_n|·exp(iφ)).

props.spectrum: flat magnitude; phase from reference at low freq

label: from code

audit.note: The node does not do the inverse FFT. latent_frequency_domain.py:214-220 returns magnitude and mixed phase as two latents; CombineLatentPhaseMagnitude does polar+ifft2 (lines 112-113). The phase mix is a plain linear blend of angles, which can wrap.
